game.name: Divinity II : Ego Draconis (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: Divinity II: Ego Draconis is an Xbox 360 role-playing game set in Rivellon, a timeless magical world shaken by apocalyptic wars. The player embodies a Dragon Slayer who can evolve into a Dragon Lord. He must make good use of every skill, potion or trick to defeat the fearsome fantasy creatures he encounters.
